records.subject: Sorry to see you go
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

This confirms the cancellation of your Wrenfield plan. Sorry to see Quartz Analytics go -- if there's feedback on what didn't work, I'd genuinely like to hear it.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: Quartz Analytics canceled -- anyone have context on what happened?

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Account is engaged: first project reached day 3, welcome call held as scheduled [calendar:5c365d1e], Pro plan, no tickets or complaints. But no invites sent and no activity signal since 8/11 [email:1529771f]; 8 days left. Quiet post-call accounts often drift, so moderate-low unaided odds.

draft.subject: Quick next step after our welcome call
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks again for making time for the welcome call last week. You've got your first project set up, which is the main thing 
i projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is usually getting the team into that project alongside you.

If it's helpful, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work to walk through that first step together? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Chidi
